text:
AlertBot: [ALERT] 1856123456 - embeddings-service errors > 0.8% in eu-central-1 for 2m. Auto-escalate: page oncall.
OpsBot: paging Ravi (sev=2) :loud_sound:
Ravi: ack. looking at logs now. seeing grpc stream resets and some 'no space for KV' warnings from the embed-worker group.
Kelsey: I can repro locally with a short synthetic load. error surface looks tied to embedding cache eviction thrashing when concurrent loads spike.
Tao: any customers reporting failures or just internal synths?
Ravi: two customers reported failures via support (tickets #9872, #9875). Not widespread but affecting high-traffic tenants doing bulk-embed.
Product-Liaison: ping on customer impact — are SLAs breached? need to decide if we push status page.
Kelsey: current SLO is p99 latency 500ms and error rate <0.5%. We're at p99 ~1.2s and error ~0.9% sustained 3m for top tenants. I'd recommend status page and an advisory.
Tao: mitigation options: 1) throttle bulk-embed routes per-tenant, 2) overflow to smaller embedding model, 3) bump cache size on pool if capacity allows.
Ravi: quick action: enable per-tenant rate-limit for bulk-embed endpoints and route new bulk jobs to embeddings-fallback pool. I'll flip those in routing for eu-central-1.
Alert-Config-Bot: created alert-mute for noisy latency alerts in eu-central-1 for 15m to avoid repeat paging (action id: mute-7423).
Kelsey: after routing change p99 dropped to 480ms within 90s, error rate 0.15%. Good.
Product-Liaison: I'm drafting the status page. I'll recommend customers retry with exponential backoff and suggest using the fallback model if latency matters.
Ravi: triage notes: we lack a per-tenant embedding-cache hit metric which slowed diagnosis. Need a dashboard tile for embed_cache_hit_ratio and eviction_rate per-pool.
Tao: agree. Also alert tuning proposal: currently page on error_rate >0.5% for 1m. That alerts on transient punishments. Proposal: change to composite alert: page only when (error_rate>0.5% for 3m) AND (p99_latency>0.8s for 3m) OR (top-tenants_error_rate>1% for 2m).
Kelsey: +1. Also add a ticket-level alert for spikes that are short-lived: (error_rate>0.5% for 1m) -> create ticket in eng-sre, don't page.
Ravi: I'll open PR with those rule changes and add a migration note to severity-matrix.md. PR draft link: https://git.redwood/ops/alert-rules/pulls/1250
Alert-Config-Bot: PR 1250 created: composite-embed-alerts. CI lint pass pending.
Tao: runbook update needed: add steps on when to route to embeddings-fallback and when to increase per-pool cache. Also include per-tenant suppression flow for business critical tenants.
Ravi: runbook snippet I'm adding:
```
# embeddings service high-error runbook
if (error_rate/top-tenants > 1% for 2m):
  - apply routing override: prefer:embeddings-fallback
  - throttle bulk-embed endpoints for noisy tenants
  - set alert: page owners, mark support notify
elif (error_rate > 0.5% for 1m):
  - open ticket in eng-sre
  - add dashboard markers and start trace capture
```
Kelsey: also note: add a post-incident dashboard that shows eviction_rate, cache_free_bytes, per-tenant concurrent_loads.
Product-Liaison: support will send an update to the affected customers referencing the status page and the temporary workaround. We'll compile a customer timeline after incident.
Ravi: handoff note for next oncall @Tao: I've captured heap/profiler snapshots in s3://redwood-incidents/1856123456/ and linked traces in the runbook. Keep monitoring for 30m before closing.
Tao: taking handoff. will watch for regressions. I'll also push the dashboard changes as a temporary tile under /dashboards/embeds-1856123456
Alert-Config-Bot: added config note to PR 1250 requesting reviewers: @eng-sre @observability
Kelsey: one more ask: add an annotation in the severity matrix: "page only if end-user facing error AND sustained impact on customers" — reduces pager noise from background jobs.
Ravi: agreed. We'll update severity-mapping doc and schedule a short sync with product and support to agree on customer-facing thresholds.
Product-Liaison: FYI — CSMs asked for per-tenant opt-out for automatic routing to fallback models. We'll need an opt-out flag in tenant metadata.
Ravi: noted. I'll add a ticket to product backlog: tenant-routing-optout-1856123456.
Tao: metrics look stable for 12m. I'll keep monitors on for 45m and then close the incident if clean.
OpsBot: incident mitigation logged: 1856123456 - routing override + per-tenant throttle applied. Monitoring window started.
Ravi: good work everyone. postmortem action items: 1) PR 1250 merge, 2) add embed cache metrics to onboarding tests, 3) runbook & severity-matrix updates, 4) UI flag for tenant opt-out. Assigning owners in the runbook.
Product-Liaison: I'll gather customer-impact notes and send to stakeholders in 2h. Support will follow up with the two affected tenants.
